title: 無振動精密實驗平台
subcategoryTitle: 低溫、真空與精密實驗平台
summary: 以一張 1000 kg 蜂巢光學桌與四支 1.5 Hz 氣墊隔振腳為主線，說明樓板 VC 等級如何經傳遞率變成桌面奈米級運動，再把桌面模態、主動隔振的傾斜極限、熱與聲學漂移和管線振動短路整合成可量測、可交接的平台驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Follow a 1000 kg honeycomb optical table on four 1.5 Hz pneumatic legs to see how a floor VC class becomes nanometre tabletop motion through transmissibility, then integrate table modes, the tilt limit of active isolation, thermal and acoustic drift and vibration short circuits through hoses into a measurable, transferable platform acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」與「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" and "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單自由度隔振器」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。地面運動以傳遞率 T(f) 傳到桌面：f 遠低於 f₀ 時桌面跟著地面走（T ≈ 1），f = f₀ 時共振放大，只有在 f > √2·f₀ 之後才開始隔振，無阻尼時隨 (f/f₀)⁻² 下降。阻尼壓低共振峰，卻在高頻把衰減斜率從 40 dB/decade 拉回到約 20 dB/decade，因此精密平台必須在共振放大與高頻隔振之間取捨。要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單自由度隔振器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). Ground motion reaches the top through the transmissibility T(f): well below f0 the top follows the ground (T ≈ 1), at f0 it is amplified, and isolation starts only above √2·f0, falling as (f/f0)⁻² when undamped. Damping lowers the resonant peak but at high frequency pulls the roll-off from 40 dB/decade back toward 20 dB/decade, so a precision platform trades resonant amplification against high-frequency isolation. Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單自由度隔振器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「無振動精密實驗平台」的「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: mechanism and system boundary” in “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" is correct?
options: 隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。
無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。
樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
optionsEn: An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency.
A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m).
A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
quiz.explanation: 無振動平台的核心是一個質量—彈簧—阻尼系統：桌面質量 m 坐在剛度 k 的支撐上，自然頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(k/m)。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A vibration-isolated platform is at heart a mass–spring–damper: the tabletop mass m sits on supports of stiffness k with natural frequency f0 = (1/2π)√(k/m). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單自由度隔振器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：無阻尼 T = 1/|1 − (f/f₀)²|：f₀ = 1.5 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 r = 6.67，T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023（−32.8 dB）。加阻尼比 ζ = 0.1 後 T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038，共振峰 T(f₀) ≈ 5.1。若用鋼彈簧做 1.5 Hz，需靜變形 δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m；10 Hz 的橡膠墊只需 2.5 mm，但在 10 Hz 完全不隔振。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). With a damping ratio ζ = 0.1, T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038 and the resonant peak T(f0) ≈ 5.1. A 1.5 Hz steel spring would need a static deflection δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m, whereas a 10 Hz rubber pad needs only 2.5 mm but gives no isolation at 10 Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). With a damping ratio ζ = 0.1, T = √(1 + (2ζr)²)/√((1 − r²)² + (2ζr)²) ≈ 0.038 and the resonant peak T(f0) ≈ 5.1. A 1.5 Hz steel spring would need a static deflection δ = 9.81/(2π×1.5)² ≈ 0.11 m, whereas a 10 Hz rubber pad needs only 2.5 mm but gives no isolation at 10 Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off", which statement holds?
options: 桌面越重越好，重量本身就能保證桌上元件之間沒有相對運動。
只要隔振夠好，光路就不會漂移。
optionsEn: A heavier top is always better because mass alone guarantees no relative motion between components on it.
Good enough isolation means optical paths cannot drift.
quiz.explanationEn: Undamped, T = 1/|1 − (f/f0)²|: with f0 = 1.5 Hz and f = 10 Hz, r = 6.67 and T = 1/(44.4 − 1) ≈ 0.023 (−32.8 dB). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單自由度隔振器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。
knowledge.textEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off"?
options: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。
optionsEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.
quiz.explanation: 在地面與桌面同時放置地震儀或加速度計，以環境振動或小型激振器為輸入，計算 H(f) = S_xy/S_xx 與相干函數，讀出共振頻率、峰值與高頻斜率，並與所選 f₀、ζ 的模型曲線疊圖；垂直與兩個水平方向都要量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place seismometers or accelerometers on the floor and on the tabletop simultaneously, use ambient vibration or a small shaker as input, compute H(f) = S_xy/S_xx with its coherence, read off the resonance, peak value and high-frequency slope, and overlay the model curve for the chosen f0 and ζ; measure the vertical and both horizontal axes. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單自由度隔振器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要把 f₀ 壓到 1 到 2 Hz，靜變形 δ = g/(2πf₀)² 必須達到十公分等級，這是鋼彈簧做不到、改用空氣彈簧的根本原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pushing f0 to 1 to 2 Hz demands a static deflection δ = g/(2πf0)² of order ten centimetres, which steel springs cannot provide and is the basic reason for air springs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔振器在任何頻率都能減少振動，自然頻率附近也一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An isolator reduces vibration at every frequency, including near its natural frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。
knowledge.textEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段。
樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common.
A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
quiz.explanation: 為了加快沉降而把阻尼調得過高，共振峰雖降到 2 以下，但 10 到 30 Hz 的隔振量損失一半以上，正好落在建築與機台最常見的振動頻段；反之阻尼不足時，人走過或關門會激起持續數秒的 1 到 2 Hz 晃動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising damping to speed settling pulls the resonant peak below 2 but loses more than half the isolation from 10 to 30 Hz, exactly where building and machinery vibration is most common; with too little damping, footsteps or a closing door excite seconds of 1 to 2 Hz sway. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」如何決定無振動精密實驗平台的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” determines the key performance of “Vibration-isolated precision platforms”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。以速度定義代表在固定速度下位移 x = v/(2πf) 隨頻率下降，所以低頻的位移最大，也最難隔離。振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz. A velocity criterion means displacement x = v/(2πf) falls with frequency at constant velocity, so low frequencies carry the largest displacement and are the hardest to isolate. Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源
knowledge.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources
knowledge.text: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。通用振動準則（VC 曲線）以三分之一倍頻帶的 rms 速度規範樓板：VC-A 50 µm/s、VC-B 25、VC-C 12.5、VC-D 6.25、VC-E 3.12 µm/s，每級減半，在約 1 到 80 Hz 範圍內為定值。
knowledge.textEn: Platform design starts from the site input. The generic vibration criteria (VC curves) specify floor motion as one-third-octave rms velocity: VC-A 50 µm/s, VC-B 25, VC-C 12.5, VC-D 6.25 and VC-E 3.12 µm/s, halving at each step and flat over roughly 1 to 80 Hz.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources" is correct?
options: 樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。
負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。
平台設計從場址的輸入開始。
optionsEn: A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it.
The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
Platform design starts from the site input.
quiz.explanation: 平台設計從場址的輸入開始。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Platform design starts from the site input. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。16 Hz 頻帶：124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm；31.5 Hz：63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm。但若 2 Hz 頻帶達到 VC-C 上限，995 nm 經 T ≈ 1.26 反被放大到約 1.25 µm，顯示 VC 等級本身無法描述隔振器共振附近的風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. In the 16 Hz band 124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm, and at 31.5 Hz 63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm. A 2 Hz band at the VC-C limit, 995 nm, is instead amplified by T ≈ 1.26 to about 1.25 µm, showing that a VC class alone cannot describe the risk near the isolator resonance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。16 Hz 頻帶：124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm；31.5 Hz：63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm。但若 2 Hz 頻帶達到 VC-C 上限，995 nm 經 T ≈ 1.26 反被放大到約 1.25 µm，顯示 VC 等級本身無法描述隔振器共振附近的風險。
knowledge.textEn: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. In the 16 Hz band 124 nm × 0.021 ≈ 2.6 nm, and at 31.5 Hz 63 nm × 0.0098 ≈ 0.6 nm. A 2 Hz band at the VC-C limit, 995 nm, is instead amplified by T ≈ 1.26 to about 1.25 µm, showing that a VC class alone cannot describe the risk near the isolator resonance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources", which statement holds?
options: 任何加速度計都能量到 1 Hz 的奈米級振動。
主動隔振可以消除所有頻率的振動，包括 0.01 Hz 的長週期晃動。
optionsEn: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm.
Any accelerometer can measure nanometre vibration at 1 Hz.
Active isolation removes vibration at every frequency, including 0.01 Hz long-period sway.
quiz.explanation: VC-C 樓板在 8 Hz 頻帶：x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm；經 f₀ = 1.5 Hz、ζ = 0.1 的隔振器（T ≈ 0.053）後桌面約 13 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: On a VC-C floor in the 8 Hz band, x = 12.5×10⁻⁶/(2π×8) ≈ 249 nm; through an isolator with f0 = 1.5 Hz and ζ = 0.1 (T ≈ 0.053) the tabletop moves about 13 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。
knowledge.textEn: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖。
纜線很軟，對隔振效果沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves.
Cables are soft, so they have no effect on isolation.
quiz.explanation: 在預定位置以低雜訊地震儀量測至少 24 小時，涵蓋上班時段與夜間，轉成三分之一倍頻帶 rms 速度頻譜並與 VC 曲線疊圖；同時以聲級計量 31.5 Hz 到 1 kHz 的聲壓頻譜，以多點溫度記錄器量空調週期造成的溫度波動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey the intended location with a low-noise seismometer for at least 24 hours covering working hours and night, convert to one-third-octave rms velocity spectra and overlay the VC curves; at the same time record the sound-pressure spectrum from 31.5 Hz to 1 kHz with a sound-level meter and the HVAC-cycle temperature swing with multi-point loggers. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板振動頻譜與 VC 曲線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Floor vibration spectrum and VC curves” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：振動之外，空調氣流、聲壓與局部熱源會直接作用在桌面上的元件，不經過隔振器，必須另外列入預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beyond vibration, HVAC airflow, sound pressure and local heat sources act directly on components on the tabletop without passing through the isolators and must be budgeted separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板達到 VC-C，放上去的任何儀器都能達到奈米穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A VC-C floor guarantees nanometre stability for any instrument placed on it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。
knowledge.textEn: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「環境輸入：樓板 VC 準則、聲學與熱源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Environmental input: floor VC criteria, acoustics and heat sources" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
負載越重，氣墊隔振腳的自然頻率就越低。
只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The heavier the load, the lower a pneumatic leg's natural frequency.
Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance.
quiz.explanation: 只看單一頻帶的最大值而忽略頻譜形狀，可能放過 2 到 4 Hz 的樓板共振；平台裝好後該頻段剛好落在隔振器放大區，影像或干涉訊號出現週期性晃動，事後只能改樓板或改用主動隔振。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judging only the peak band level while ignoring spectral shape can miss a 2 to 4 Hz floor resonance; once the platform is installed that band falls in the isolator's amplification region, images or interference signals show periodic sway, and the remedy becomes a floor retrofit or active isolation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
